data.long_meaning: Owaiza is derived from the Arabic root 'aww' which means 'to be strong' or 'powerful'. This name is often given to boys in the Muslim world to signify strength, victory, and courage. The name Owaiza carries the meaning “Strong, Powerful, Victorious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Owaiza usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, powerful, victorious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
